description.value:
Extensive cybernetic reconstruction has made you more machine than living being, provided you were rebuilt in a configuration resembling your original species.

Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Choose a droid class (I through V, or tracker); you gain that creature type in addition to your existing type or types.

You gain resistance to necrotic and poison damage, and immunity to the poisoned condition and to disease.

You no longer need to eat or drink, and you no longer need a tech focus to cast tech powers.

You gain vulnerability to ion damage, and you have disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal ion or lightning damage.

You lose the ability to sense the Force, use force powers, or take levels in forcecasting classes.

You can no longer be targeted by cybernetic augmentations or genetic mutations, but you can now be targeted by droid customizations.
